subject: general
question: Which of the following autobiographies is written by the great Indian santoor player Shiv Kumar Sharma in 2002?

options.text: Journey with a Hundred Strings: My Life in Music
Abba - God’s greatest Gift to Us

solution:
The correct answer is __**Journey with a Hundred Strings; My Life in Music**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Journey with a Hundred Strings: My Life in Music is written by the great Indian santoor player Shiv Kumar Sharma in 2002. **

 
 
• **Indian classical musician and santoor player Pandit Shivkumar Sharma **(13 January 1938) is **credited with modifying the santoor for Indian classical music**.
 
• He cooperated as a music composer with I**ndian flautist Hariprasad Chaurasia and wrote the music for numerous Indian movies, such as Faasle (1985), Chandni (1989), and Lamhe (1991)**.
 
• **In 2002, **Shiv Kumar Sharma wrote an autobiography** ****"Journey with a Hundred Strings: My Life in Music."**
 
• In **1986**, Sharma received the** Sangeet Natak Akademi Award**.
 
• In **1991**, he received the** Padma Shri**, India's fourth-highest civilian honour, and in **2001**, he received the** Padma Bhushan**, the nation's third-highest civilian honour.
